title: Morning Prayers
provenance: Traditional received English, in the forms in common liturgical use and long out of copyright. NOT transcribed from any modern published prayer book — those translations are copyrighted. Confirm with Father that these match what the parish actually says.

blocks.text: Rising from sleep, stand before your icons and collect yourself a moment before beginning.

blocks.en: Having risen from sleep, we fall down before Thee, O Good One, and sing to Thee, O Mighty One, the angelic hymn: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God; through the Theotokos have mercy on us.

Having raised me from my bed and from sleep, O Lord, enlighten my mind and my heart, and open my lips that I may praise Thee, O Holy Trinity: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God; through the Theotokos have mercy on us.
Suddenly the Judge shall come, and the deeds of each shall be revealed; but with fear we cry out in the middle of the night: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God; through the Theotokos have mercy on us.

Having risen from sleep, I thank Thee, O Holy Trinity, for through Thy great goodness and long-suffering Thou wast not angered with me, an idler and a sinner, nor hast Thou destroyed me in my transgressions; but Thou hast shown Thy usual love for mankind, and hast raised me up as I lay in heedlessness, that I might rise early and glorify Thy power.

blocks.text: The Prayer of St. Basil the Great

blocks.en: O Lord Almighty, God of the powers and of all flesh, who dwellest on high and lookest down on things that are lowly: Thou knowest the hearts and the reins, and Thou clearly foreknowest the secrets of men. O Beginningless and Everlasting Light, in whom is no change nor shadow of turning: receive our morning prayers, and forgive us our sins, both voluntary and involuntary.

blocks.text: The Prayer of St. Macarius the Great

blocks.en: O God, cleanse me a sinner, for I have never done anything good in Thy sight; but deliver me from the evil one, and let Thy will be done in me, that I may open my unworthy mouth without condemnation and praise Thy holy name, of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, now and ever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen.

I believe in one God, the Father Almighty, Maker of heaven and earth, and of all things visible and invisible. And in one Lord Jesus Christ, the only-begotten Son of God, begotten of the Father before all ages; Light of Light, true God of true God, begotten, not made, of one essence with the Father, by whom all things were made; who for us men and for our salvation came down from heaven, and was incarnate of the Holy Spirit and the Virgin Mary, and became man; and was crucified for us under Pontius Pilate, and suffered and was buried; and rose again on the third day according to the Scriptures; and ascended into heaven, and sitteth at the right hand of the Father; and shall come again with glory to judge the living and the dead, whose kingdom shall have no end. And in the Holy Spirit, the Lord, the Giver of Life, who proceedeth from the Father, who together with the Father and the Son is worshipped and glorified, who spake by the prophets. In one holy, catholic and apostolic Church. I confess one baptism for the remission of sins. I look for the resurrection of the dead, and the life of the age to come. Amen.
blocks.el: Πιστεύω εἰς ἕνα Θεόν, Πατέρα, Παντοκράτορα, ποιητὴν οὐρανοῦ καὶ γῆς, ὁρατῶν τε πάντων καὶ ἀοράτων.

blocks.en: O holy angel, attendant upon my wretched soul and my afflicted life: forsake me not, a sinner, neither depart from me for my incontinence. Give no place to the evil demon to subdue me by the oppression of this mortal body; but take me by my wretched and outstretched hand, and lead me in the way of salvation.

blocks.text: Remember here those you have been asked to pray for, and any you have wronged.

blocks.en: O Lord, save and have mercy on my spiritual father, my parents, my family, and all Orthodox Christians. Remember, O Lord, the souls of Thy departed servants, and forgive them every sin, voluntary and involuntary, and grant them the Kingdom and a portion in Thine eternal good things.

It is truly meet to bless thee, O Theotokos, ever-blessed and most pure, and the Mother of our God. More honourable than the Cherubim, and beyond compare more glorious than the Seraphim: without corruption thou gavest birth to God the Word. True Theotokos, we magnify thee.
blocks.el: Ἄξιόν ἐστιν ὡς ἀληθῶς μακαρίζειν σε τὴν Θεοτόκον, τὴν ἀειμακάριστον καὶ παναμώμητον καὶ μητέρα τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν.

blocks.en: Through the prayers of our holy fathers, O Lord Jesus Christ our God, have mercy on us and save us. Amen.
blocks.el: Δι' εὐχῶν τῶν ἁγίων Πατέρων ἡμῶν, Κύριε Ἰησοῦ Χριστὲ ὁ Θεός, ἐλέησον καὶ σῶσον ἡμᾶς. Ἀμήν.
